name: El Valle de Abbatis
source:
You play as Jefferson, a soldier left for dead on the dunes of Mars, rescued by a salvaging party from a nearby outpost.

[From [url=https://nicolasgn.itch.io/el-valle-de-abbatis-game-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演士兵Jefferson。他被遺棄在火星的沙丘上等死，後來被附近哨站的一支廢料回收隊救起。

[摘自[url=https://nicolasgn.itch.io/el-valle-de-abbatis-game-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
